label: Detocs system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Detocs locus represented in DefenseFinder by DtcA and DtcB profiles plus optional DtcC-family profiles, with an ATP nucleosidase output that can degrade ATP and dATP upon phage infection and halt phage propagation.
observations: Detocs branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual dtcA, dtcB, or dtcC genes, Dtc proteins, Detocs HMM profiles, DtcC REase/TOPRIM/hydrolase subtypes, ATP nucleosidase activity outside a complete Detocs locus, generic two-component phosphotransfer signaling, source-database rows naming one Detocs locus, unresolved Detocs phage triggers, unresolved DtcC-variant effector outputs, and other phage defense systems.
